scope: R2 scan-result UI rendering of same-installation entrypoint version conflicts
status: implemented-and-ui-verified; real host scan not performed
implementation: ExternalEnv gains an optional versionConflicts array mirroring the Rust payload
each affected entry renders a status block listing every conflicting launcher with its reported version or its probe error
the block states that one installation record was kept and asks the user to verify the entrypoints in a new terminal
the collapsed group header shows an aggregate 'N 个入口版本不一致' marker so the conflict is visible without expanding
paths use break-all and the list is width-constrained, so long launcher paths wrap instead of overflowing at 390px

uiCoverage.scan-ui: the Node.js fixture carries two conflicts (one with a version, one with a probe error); the test asserts the aggregate header marker, the block heading, both paths, the version text and the error text, then asserts no horizontal overflow at 390px and captures tests/scan-conflicts-390.png

ui.command: node tests/run-ui.mjs <global playwright module> tests/settings-ui.mjs tests/startup-ui.mjs tests/release-052-ui.mjs tests/download-ui.mjs tests/package-manager-update-ui.mjs tests/scans-ui.mjs tests/scan-ui.mjs tests/sizes-ui.mjs tests/packages-ui.mjs

notVerified: No real host installation with divergent launcher versions was scanned; the UI was driven by a simulated backend
limitations: The conflict block lives inside the expanded entry, so a user must expand the tool to see individual paths
Only the aggregate count appears when collapsed
The UI does not offer a remediation action; it points the user to verify in a new terminal
